eligibility_reason: The original descriptive ERP/choice findings are meaningful reproduction targets even though stronger coefficients cannot define superiority. Formula and input-preparation support exists, but complete original targets/companions, scientific criteria and computation-verification/execution identities remain unresolved; this is independent of improvement ineligibility.

source_paper.title: Separable neural signals for reward and emotion prediction errors

evidence.locator: Fig. 3; Methods: Participants, Psychophysiological recording and processing, Analyses; Data availability; primary Results accompanying Fig. 3, local erp-paper.txt lines 1237–1257: four conditional coefficients/SE/CIs and conditional/unconditional P3b comparisons
evidence.supports: The paper tests dissociation of reward, valence and arousal PE associations with FRN/P3a/P3b and choices in 41 participants; it reports mixed-effects inference rather than a held-out ERP/choice prediction benchmark. Four original conditional beta values are verified documentary targets, with source-reported SE/CIs retained as evidence and all scientific reproduction criteria unresolved.

evidence.locator: analysis/eeg_epe_ms.Rmd: inputs (lines 47–55 in retained remote transcript); fig3_data positional joins/filter (204–212); conditional FRN/P3a/P3b models (224–229,255–260,286–291); unconditional companions (232–284,300–322); source P3b contrast (294–299); fig2b_model and round reparameterizations (381–419). Line numbers are the inspected remote rendering, not a newly hashed local source file. Existing local erp-code.txt cache lines 300–370 confirms three P3a unconditional models, two P3b unconditional models only, and separate conditional valence-minus-reward versus unconditional reward-minus-valence comparisons; this cache is separately hashed externally and is not a new authenticated author-code manifest.
evidence.supports: Source formulas, input names, ordered joins and first filter are source-observed. Conditional P3b source contrast omits coefficient covariance and applies pnorm(-abs(z)); this must remain distinct from the later covariance-aware two-sided diagnostic. This source inspection supplies no fitted coefficients or empirical result. The unconditional P3b arousal model is absent and must not be inferred from the other ERPs; the second original P3b contrast is retained as an effect estimate, with z/probability arithmetic as granular verification evidence.

Local scored endpoint is equal-model coefficient RMSE in reference standard errors, with fixed conditional REML models and row-order correspondence assumed. It explicitly disclaims independent improvement.

evidence.locator: BEH_ug.csv and the seven FRN/P2/P3a/P3b offer/baseline CSVs named in registered-runtime/public_contract.json
evidence.supports: The complete original processed panel is pinned by eight public byte counts/SHA256 values. ERP files have no independent trial keys; actual preparation by the new component remains unrun.

Executable pinned-input preparer preserves source rows, unchanged scaled strings and formula-specific cases. Thirteen generated controls and independent row/string controls passed; no authentic preparation, fitting, AI execution or complete reproduction occurred.

target.description: Distinct relationships of reward and emotion prediction errors with FRN, P3a and P3b amplitudes, and associations with subsequent social choices; registered central scope reconstructs the fixed mixed-effects coefficients and uncertainty.

dataset.description: Author processed behavior and ERP CSVs in 2025_epe_eeg at revision 4f5767df1516e0ec3c234d51ba36e4b741eb60e8; continuous cleaned EEG is a separate input level and raw-to-ERP reproduction is outside the registered numerical component.

cohort.description: 41 participants, 180 repeated Ultimatum Game trials each and 36 partners per participant. Author analyses exclude invalid/missing affect reports and use model-specific complete cases; the local contract counts 6,403 rows but this is not a published predictive test set.

split.description: The source central models fit the measured participant cohort with participant random effects. There is no published held-out participant/partner split for the registered coefficient-dissociation endpoint.

inputs.description: Trial reward and affect expectations/experiences, choices, participant identifiers, and extracted offer-locked FRN/P2/P3a/P3b and baseline ERP amplitudes. Source PE values are experience minus expectation.

preprocessing.description: 500-Hz EEG; average reference, eye-artifact correction, 0.1–40-Hz filtering, offer epochs −200–800 ms and artifact rejection. Single-trial windows: FRN 315–415 ms, P3a 363–463 ms and P3b 530–630 ms with source ROIs/covariates. PE standardization preserves meaningful zero; author CSV joins are positional.

metric.description: Source fixed-effect estimates and uncertainty for PE terms in participant mixed-effects ERP models, including contrasts across PE coefficients; these are inferential estimands, not a predictive accuracy target.

aggregation.description: Separate FRN/P3a/P3b models retain participant random effects over trials. Participant is the independent sampling unit; the local equal-model coefficient RMSE is only reference-reconstruction aggregation.

full_panel.description: Registered processed-table panel requires the three conditional FRN/P3a/P3b fixed-effect vectors; three source PE-specific unconditional effects for FRN, three for P3a and two for P3b; both original P3b contrast effect estimates (conditional valence-minus-reward and unconditional reward-minus-valence); and source ERP-by-round choice effects. Full covariance, literal author contrast statistics, covariance-aware conditional diagnostic corrections, model designs and fitted outputs are mandatory granular verification evidence, not separately scored original findings. Four published conditional magnitudes are documentary targets; the remaining magnitudes, complete companion/choice closure and scientific acceptance remain unresolved. This is not continuous-EEG or whole-paper reconstruction.

permitted_observations.description: The paper and the complete eight pinned public processed behavior/ERP CSVs are allowed observations, including the original participant/trial/partner identities, source-scaled columns and model-specific missingness. The +author-code arm may additionally receive only the pinned author RMarkdown and an authenticated code manifest. Published tables are exposed references; historical private numerical targets, solver answers and unregistered continuous-EEG preprocessing outputs are not participant inputs.

blocking_issues: Four published conditional beta values and reported SE/CIs are authenticated documentary targets from the cached primary paper; the remaining 32 effect magnitudes and complete companion/choice targets remain unresolved. Historical private references and solver answers were not accessed; copied paper values cannot establish executed analysis.

No scientific tolerance or independent reproduction uncertainty/decision rule is justified for the full panel. The source one-tail independent-SE P3b comparison differs from the preserved covariance-aware two-sided diagnostic; source reproduction and inferential correction must be reported separately.

The public processed-inputs-v1/prepare.py command is runnable preparation only: it emits three conditional model CSVs and receipts, never fitted parameters, covariance, likelihood, random effects, predictions or source-derived findings. Authentic eight-table preparation remains unrun.

The historical registered-runtime/score.py facade requires absent authoring dependencies and accepts aggregate summaries; it is neither a portable submitted-analysis interface nor proof of computation from data. Historical runner/qualification declarations do not establish a current authenticated execution route.

No complete runnable submitted-analysis interface or independently pinned verification program exists for conditional, unconditional and choice models. Required granular outputs are original source-row masks/design matrices, model-specific fitted values/residuals, random/fixed effects, covariance, convergence/likelihood evidence and both explicitly labeled P3b contrast calculations. A program printing tables is insufficient.

ERP/behavior linkage remains the author positional assumption; behavior trial keys and file hashes do not independently establish ERP trial correspondence. Continuous-EEG-to-ERP extraction is outside the registered processed-data component and remains unresolved.

The complete companion panel and source choice coding/round-1 and round-5 reparameterization outputs require further exact-source closure; the current minimum required panel does not certify whole-paper coverage.

No fresh authenticated common-input, author-code-only addition, ordered full-panel, permitted-observation, exposure/evaluator or cumulative-budget manifests exist for the two information conditions. Both pairing protocols remain null; no AI result or historical promotion is admitted.

Covariance matrices and contrast z/probability outputs are required granular uncertainty/diagnostic evidence, not additional original scientific findings. The full verifier design is documented externally; no runnable independent verifier or scientific band has been implemented.

Publication hold: the integration owner must correct current canonical improvement-only wording, supply the final integrated current-task commit/raw hash and repin outcomes.original_task_sha256. The present raw hash is real current group-cutoff metadata, not a final publication pin.

Existing primary code cache confirms eight unconditional PE models, not nine: P3b has reward-only and valence-only models, with no arousal-only fit. Both original conditional and unconditional P3b effect comparisons are required, using their different source subtraction directions. Source z/probability statistics remain verification evidence; nonrejection is not evidence of equivalence.
